quickAnswer: Dalaman Airport (DLM), operated by YDA Group with an annual capacity of 17.5 million passengers, is the closest gateway to Türkiye's Turquoise Coast marinas and bays. Road transfers reach Göcek in 25 minutes, Dalyan in 30 minutes, Fethiye in 50 minutes, Marmaris in 80 minutes, and Kaş in roughly 2 hours along the D400 highway.

body.text: Whether arriving for a gulet charter in Göcek or a coastal villa stay near Fethiye and Kaş, ground logistics at DLM revolve around the D400 corridor and electronic tunnel tolls. This dalaman airport dlm guide outlines exact transfer durations, Göcek Tunnel HGS rules, marina luggage planning, and seasonal international flight schedules.
How close is DLM to Göcek (25 min), Dalyan (30 min), Fethiye (50 min) and Kaş (2 hrs)?

Dalaman Airport puts Göcek marinas just 22 kilometers (25 minutes) east and Dalyan 28 kilometers (30 minutes) northwest. Continuing east along the D400 highway takes 50 minutes to Fethiye, 60 minutes to Ölüdeniz, and roughly 2 hours to Kalkan or Kaş, while heading west reaches Marmaris in 80 to 90 minutes.

Operated under [YDA Aviation](https://www.yda.com.tr/en/aviation/) alongside [DHMİ Muğla Dalaman Airport](https://dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Dalaman/AnaSayfa.aspx), the expanded terminal complex handles both domestic and international flights in adjacent buildings, as noted by the [Dalaman District Governorate](https://www.dalaman.gov.tr/yda-dalaman-havalimani). Traffic flows smoothly outside peak Saturday charter turnovers, when coastal road junctions near Fethiye and Göcek slow by 15 to 20 minutes.
How does the Göcek Tunnel toll work?

The Göcek Tunnel between Dalaman Airport and Göcek operates strictly on Türkiye's electronic HGS (Fast Pass System) with no cash or manual card lanes. Under [2026 Göcek Tunnel toll rates](https://www.yelkenrentacar.com/blog/gocek-tunnel-toll-fee-2026), Class 1 passenger cars pay 75 TL and Class 2 minibuses pay 150 TL per crossing, billed automatically to the vehicle's HGS tag.

Per the [General Directorate of Highways (KGM) HGS guide](https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteEng/Root/HGSeng.aspx), rental cars registered in Türkiye carry an active windshield HGS sticker whose tolls are settled by the rental agency upon return. Licensed private transfers normally include the Göcek Tunnel toll in their quoted fixed fare, whereas taking the winding mountain bypass road to avoid the toll adds 15 minutes of steep hairpins.
Which private transfers handle yacht-marina luggage cleanly?

Standard sedans rarely fit four passengers plus hard-shell suitcases and sailing gear. For yacht embarkations at D-Marin Göcek, Skopea Marina, or Ece Saray Marina in Fethiye, book a long-wheelbase Mercedes Vito (up to 6 passengers) or Mercedes Sprinter (7 to 14 passengers) with a dedicated rear cargo bay and confirmed marina-gate clearance.
Use this marina-transfer checklist before confirming a DLM pickup:

items: Specify soft duffels vs. hard suitcases: Tell your transfer operator exact bag counts and any oversized dive, kite, or provisioning cases.
Share your yacht name and berth: Drivers need the exact marina gate (for example, D-Marin vs. Göcek Municipal Marina) to pull close to the pontoon.
Request a supermarket stop upfront: Many charter groups add a 30-minute provisioning pause near Göcek; agree on waiting fees in advance.
Verify HGS and parking inclusion: Confirm the quote covers airport parking and the Göcek Tunnel toll in both directions.

body.text: When do seasonal international flights operate?

Direct international flights into Dalaman Airport run primarily from late March through early November, peaking between May and October with dense routes from the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, and Scandinavia. Between November and March, international schedules drop sharply and most travelers connect via Istanbul (IST or SAW) or Ankara on Turkish Airlines, Pegasus, or AJet.

You can check active routes and daily arrival waves on [Flightradar24's DLM airport tracker](https://www.flightradar24.com/data/airports/dlm). Because Dalaman serves a large share of UK and European holiday charters, Saturday and Sunday midday arrivals create the longest passport queues; arriving midweek or on a domestic morning flight significantly reduces wait times.

faq.q: Are Havaş or Muttaş airport buses available from Dalaman Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Havaş and Muğla municipal Muttaş coaches operate from outside DLM arrivals to Fethiye and Marmaris, timed to major domestic flights, though neither stops directly inside Göcek marinas or Kaş.

faq.q: Can I walk between the Domestic and International terminals at Dalaman Airport?
faq.a: Yes. The Domestic and International terminals sit next to each other along the same forecourt and take roughly 5 minutes to walk between on foot.

faq.q: Is the Göcek Tunnel toll charged in both directions?
faq.a: Yes. Electronic HGS cameras bill each passage through the Göcek Tunnel separately, both heading east toward Göcek/Fethiye and returning west toward Dalaman Airport.

faq.q: How early should I arrive at DLM for a summer international flight?
faq.a: Arrive 3 hours before international departure between May and October. Security screening at the terminal entrance plus check-in and passport control can take over 60 minutes during weekend charter peaks.

faq.q: Are taxis at Dalaman Airport metered?
faq.a: Yes. Official yellow airport taxis use Muğla regulated meters, though posted zone tariff boards outside arrivals give transparent reference estimates to Göcek, Dalyan, Fethiye, and Marmaris.

faq.q: Which airport is better for Kaş—Dalaman (DLM) or Antalya (AYT)?
faq.a: Dalaman (DLM) is closer at roughly 145 km (2 hours) compared with Antalya (AYT) at roughly 200 km (2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours), though AYT offers far more year-round international flights.
